verdict.rationale: CDP documents a public API: an API reference with endpoints such as checkout creation, a Checkouts API that replaces the Commerce Charge API, and a sandbox using the same endpoints and authentication as Live. The CDP CLI exposes every API endpoint as an MCP tool, and SDKs cover the same operations, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes at standard paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use.
